description: Dr. Gillespie gives two interns cases to solve to decide who will be his assistant.

description: A Hollywood producer (James Coburn) shares his Riviera yacht with six people who might have killed his wife.

description: The British Adamsons raise Elsa the lioness as a pet in Kenya, then teach her how to be wild again.

description: John, Paul, George and Ringo (The Beatles) spend 36 wild hours in London, besieged by exuberant fans.

description: A boxer (William Bishop) jailed for murder proves his girlfriend's (Ann Richards) wealthy father and a ward boss framed him.

title: Cabaret
description: Multiple Oscars went to this tale about an American chanteuse in Berlin caught in the rising tide of Nazism.

title: Lola
description: A cabaret singer (Barbara Sukowa) corrupts a stuffy city planner (Armin Mueller-Stahl) in 1957 Germany.

title: The Wheeler Dealers
description: A Texas oil rascal (James Garner) woos a Wall Street stock analyst (Lee Remick) and takes the market for a ride.

title: Wonderful World of Tupperware
description: Wonderful World of Tupperware

title: The High Cost of Loving
description: Just as a corporate executive (Jose Ferrer) fears losing his job, his wife (Gena Rowlands) thinks she's finally pregnant.

title: Breakdown
description: A boxer (William Bishop) jailed for murder proves his girlfriend's (Ann Richards) wealthy father and a ward boss framed him.

title: Casablanca
description: A cynical nightclub owner in Casablanca protects an old flame and her husband from Nazis, while also trying to navigate his complicated past.

title: The Bad and the Beautiful
description: A ruthless producer (Kirk Douglas) uses and discards Hollywood hopefuls as stepping stones to the top of the Tinseltown heap.

title: It Started With a Kiss
description: An Air Force sergeant (Glenn Ford) and his bride (Debbie Reynolds) try abstinence and tour Spain in a Lincoln Futura won in a raffle.

title: Kiss Me Kate
description: Lilli and Fred act the same way offstage as they do in The Taming of the Shrew.

title: Gone to Earth
description: Folklore and desire stir an 1890s girl (Jennifer Jones) who lives with her father in English fox-hunting country.

title: Duel in the Sun
description: Good and bad sons (Joseph Cotten, Gregory Peck) of a Texas cattle baron fight each other, and the railroad, over a dark beauty (Jennifer Jones).

title: The Wizard of Oz
description: A Kansas farm girl (Dorothy Dwan) lands in dreamland with a scarecrow (Larry Semon), prince (Bryant Washburn), tin woodman and wizard.

description: Truffaut's hero Antoine Doinel is thrown out of the army and tries to make a living while learning to handle women.

title: The Soft Skin
description: A French magazine editor's (Jean Desailly) wife (Nelly Benedetti) puts an end to his affair with a stewardess (Françoise Dorléac).

title: Happiness Ahead
description: A bored heiress (Josephine Hutchinson) leaves high society and falls in love with a window washer (Dick Powell).

title: Here Comes Happiness
description: A rich girl (Mildred Coles) loves a sandblaster (Edward Norris) instead of the socialite (Richard Ainley) her mother wants her to marry.

title: Princess O'Rourke
description: A down-to-earth pilot (Robert Cummings) charms a European princess (Olivia de Havilland) on vacation in the United States.

title: Wise Girl
description: A socialite (Miriam Hopkins) goes Bohemian to save her sister's children from their starving-artist father (Ray Milland) in Greenwich Village.

title: Traveling Saleslady
description: A toothpaste tycoon's daughter (Joan Blondell) sells an inventor's new brand to teach her father a lesson.

title: There Goes My Heart
description: A reporter finds a runaway heiress working as a salesgirl in a department store she owns.

title: Repent at Leisure
description: A young man falls in love with his boss's daughter.

title: Love and Learn
description: A New York socialite (Martha Vickers) plays working girl around two struggling songwriters (Jack Carson, Robert Hutton).

title: The Richest Girl in the World
description: An heiress (Miriam Hopkins) trades places with her secretary (Fay Wray) and meets a man (Joel McCrea) who loves her not only for her money.

title: Bride by Mistake
description: A pilot (Alan Marshal) woos a woman (Marsha Hunt) doubling for an heiress (Laraine Day), then elopes with the heiress.

title: Sun Valley Serenade
description: A band member sponsors a European war refugee who turns out to be a Nordic skater with eyes for her new guardian.

title: Orchestra Wives
description: A newlywed (Ann Rutherford) joins her husband (George Montgomery) on the road along with other wives of members of the band.

title: Birth of the Blues
description: A New Orleans clarinetist (Bing Crosby) forms a Dixieland jazz band with a trumpet player (Brian Donlevy) from Memphis.

title: Girl Crazy
description: A publisher's playboy son (Mickey Rooney) falls for the dean's granddaughter (Judy Garland) at an all-male mining school.

title: Strike Up the Band
description: A drummer (Mickey Rooney) and his singer girlfriend (Judy Garland) form a high-school swing band for a radio contest.

title: Pot o' Gold
description: A harmonica player (James Stewart) woos a landlady's daughter (Paulette Goddard) and joins a conductor's (Horace Heidt) orchestra.

title: God Is My Co-Pilot
description: Col. Robert L. Scott Jr. (Dennis Morgan) becomes a member of Gen. Chennault's (Raymond Massey) Flying Tigers in World War II.

title: My Wild Irish Rose
description: Irish balladeer Chauncey Olcott charms Lillian Russell and an alderman's daughter in the 1890s New York.

title: Two Guys From Milwaukee
description: A Brooklyn cabby (Jack Carson) and his manicurist girlfriend (Joan Leslie) meet a prince (Dennis Morgan) posing as a guy from Milwaukee.

title: The Desert Song
description: A man leads a group of desert bandits against some Nazis, who want to use them as cheap labor for their railroad.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Ten Tall Men
description: A Foreign Legion sergeant (Burt Lancaster) and his rowdy men settle tribal trouble by seizing a princess (Jody Lawrance).

title: Sweet Smell of Success
description: An all-powerful New York gossip columnist (Burt Lancaster) gives a press agent (Tony Curtis) some dirty work.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.
